brandDescription: Dr. M Experienced, with Dr. David Musnick. Practical insights from decades in sports, regenerative, internal, and functional medicine.

spotify.label: Spotify for Creators
spotify.notes: Upload the approved full video to the current Spotify-hosted show; Spotify makes the episode audio available through the canonical RSS feed. Use podcastAudio only as the fallback for an audio-only episode. Spotify does not expose a public creator episode-upload API.

apple.label: Apple Podcasts
apple.notes: Do not upload the episode separately. Apple receives the approved podcast audio from Spotify's canonical RSS feed.

amazon.label: Amazon Music and Audible
amazon.notes: Do not upload the episode separately. One-time RSS submission and ownership verification are still required before Amazon can receive the approved podcast audio from Spotify's canonical feed.

youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.notes: Use OAuth and resumable upload. New API projects keep uploads private until YouTube completes its separate compliance audit.

vimeo.label: Vimeo
vimeo.notes: Use the official Vimeo API with upload and edit scopes after app upload access is enabled.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.notes: Prefer Meta's resumable upload from the approved local Reel. Use short-lived public media staging only when resumable upload is unavailable, then remove the staged object after Meta finishes processing.

rumble.label: Rumble
rumble.notes: No documented public creator VOD-upload API is available. Keep final license, visibility, and monetization choices in an approved browser handoff.
